body.notes:
## Summary
The meeting covered the Beyric client portal launch, email notifications, budget, contract, launch-event venue, welcome-pack stock, VAT, contractor resourcing, and a login-page typo. The launch was moved to 14 March, and the remaining phase budget was capped at £4,000. The email provider and contractor decision remain open.

## Key points
- The payment integration slipped by about two weeks after the provider changed its sandbox.
- Amaka compared Postmark and Resend. Postmark had better deliverability figures in the reports she read; Resend was cheaper and had a cleaner API, according to Tunde.
- Grace prefers the venue near Liverpool Street but said either of the two options would be acceptable.
- The welcome-pack requirement was clarified as 1,500 packs, or 30 boxes.
- The login page has a product-name typo that should read Beyric.
- Grace will be travelling next week and asked for urgent items to be sent before Thursday.

## Decisions
- Move the launch to 14 March.
- Cap the remaining budget for this phase at £4,000; anything that would exceed the cap requires Grace’s sign-off.
- Defer the email-provider decision until the test results are reviewed next week.
- Defer the extra mobile-app contractor decision until the integration progress is clearer.

## Action items
- Adebayo: Update the plan with the new launch date.
- Amaka: Send a test batch through Postmark and Resend using the team’s domain by Wednesday.
- Tunde: Send Grace the revised contract with the new dates by Friday.
- Amaka: Review the two venue options Grace mentioned and handle the booking.
- Unassigned: Check whether VAT applies to international customers and identify an owner for the check.
- Amaka: Fix the login-page product-name typo today.

## Open questions
- Which email provider will be selected after the tests?
- Does VAT apply to international customers, and who will own checking this?
- Will the team hire an extra contractor for the mobile app or do the work in-house?
- Which venue option will be selected?

## Please check
None noted

body.transcript:
[Priya]: Let's get going. Three things: the partner portal, the data export, and the new hire.
[Segun]: Portal first. Design is done. I will build the login screens tomorrow and have the dashboard in the coming weeks.
[Priya]: Fine. The dashboard has no firm date, so let's say in the coming weeks.
[Ebuka]: For the data export, I will write the spec by next Monday. After that someone has to estimate the work, but we do not know who has capacity.
[Priya]: Agreed, leave the estimate unassigned for now.
[Segun]: The auditors asked for the export format soon. Whoever picks it up should reply to them.
[Priya]: Nobody volunteers, so it stays open.
[Ebuka]: New hire. HR wants the job description signed off sometime next quarter, no rush.
[Priya]: I'll review the job description at some point, but I will not commit to a date.
[Segun]: Also I will update the staging server tonight.
[Priya]: Good. We decided to keep the export in CSV for version one.
[Ebuka]: Agreed. Excel can wait.
[Priya]: Thanks all.
